parent_objective: audit M2359 repaired-pack reset-validation pass before any measured execution design
blocked_by: M2359 produces reset evidence but interpretation is deferred to a result audit
measured execution design is blocked until reset pass and claim boundary are audited
supersedes: direct measured execution after reset validation without audit
claiming paper-level evidence from reset-only validation

public_gates: M2360 must audit M2359 summary and reset artifacts without rerunning reset
M2360 must verify 360/360 reset success, zero contract violations, and repair metadata preservation
M2360 must keep rollout measured execution ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the repaired-pack reset-validation pass and decides the next bounded paper-route step
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun, rollout, ranking, paper, finite-window-vs-GRU, or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2359 summary is missing or internally inconsistent
stop if reset success, contract, repair metadata, or guardrail counts do not match M2358 gates
stop if audit routes directly to controller ranking or paper-level conclusion
fallback_plan: route to failure audit or validator repair if M2359 artifacts are inconsistent
route to bounded measured-execution design if M2359 artifacts are accepted
route to branch synthesis if the reset-validation branch should close before measured execution
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2359 produced a repaired-pack reset-validation pass

allowed_updates: M2360 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2359 reset pass is accepted or rejected
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2360 audits task-quality reset validation and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2360; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If M2359 artifacts fail audit, classify the failure before repair or rerun.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits new reset evidence over repaired candidate config packs before measured execution design
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit bounded measured-execution design if M2359 artifacts are accepted, but cannot establish driver performance
must_synthesize_if: M2360 cannot decide the next route from the M2359 artifacts
M2360 proposes direct ranking or paper conclusion
the repaired-pack reset-validation branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Auditing M2359 repaired-pack reset-validation artifacts can decide whether the reset-valid repaired packs are eligible for a bounded measured-execution design.
success_criteria: claim boundary remains blocked for ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected or the branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2360 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2360 ranks support policies or controller families
M2360 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2360 routes directly to controller comparison without measured-execution design

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual audit of M2359 repaired-pack reset-validation artifacts

decision_rule: M2360 passes if it audits M2359 artifacts and selects a bounded non-ranking follow-up route or stops the branch.
